summary: Two tests are queued and not run. First is the transfer-search shadow on 2022/23, 2023/24, and 2024/25: a rewrite is rejected if each season averages under 0.25 value points a week and has fewer than three weeks at or above 1. Second is the clean previous-season fill on the fast eleven for 2023/24, 2024/25, and 2025/26. The upper-tail reading is the haul arm already parked, so a cut at 10, 12, or 15 is not added. No engine change.
